from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInvestmentCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Investment cash flow data for a single company from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Company name")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Securities stock code")
    investment_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash flow from investment activities")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Time period of the financial report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_investment_cash_flows: list[CompanyInvestmentCashFlow]
